task1.prompt: The diagram below shows how used paper is recycled. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: How used paper is recycled
steps: Collection: recycling bins at homes and offices
Sorting plant: separated by type; plastic and staples removed
Pulping: shredded, then mixed with water and chemicals
Cleaning and de-inking: ink and glue removed
Pressing: pulp spread on screens; rollers squeeze out water
Drying: heated cylinders; wound into large rolls
Cutting and delivery: sent to factories for new paper products

The diagram below shows the stages in the production of chocolate. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features. Write at least 150 words.

visual.title: How chocolate is produced
steps: Harvesting: ripe cocoa pods cut from trees
Fermentation: beans and pulp in covered boxes, 5–7 days
Drying: beans spread in the sun, about one week
Transport: packed in sacks, shipped to factory
Grinding: beans crushed into liquid cocoa mass
Mixing: sugar and milk added; mixture refined
Moulding and cooling: bars formed, then wrapped

task2.prompt: Some people believe that university education should be free for everyone, while others think students should pay for their own studies. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.

Some people say that protecting the environment is the responsibility of governments, while others argue that individuals must change their own behaviour. Discuss both views and give your own opinion. Write at least 250 words.

Some people think governments should tax unhealthy food and drinks in order to improve public health. To what extent do you agree or disagree? Write at least 250 words.
In many countries people are living longer than ever before. What challenges does an ageing population create, and how can societies respond to them? Write at least 250 words.
Many people are moving from rural areas to large cities. Do the advantages of living in a big city outweigh the disadvantages? Write at least 250 words.
